commit.message:
feat(setup): each op on its own setup's mount; one NC file per mount

Every law that judges an existing operation now reads that operation's
own setup's machine and post instead of the active setup's: generation
(machine kind, spindle housing, rotaries), the lathe spindle law and its
stamp clause, the rest reading's lathe rule, the aligned-setup gate, the
mill-only stock carry (both ends), the fixture table (table_box per
setup), the gate's spindle-housing walk, the limit check (one check per
machine over the ops its setups run) and the retype/paste family gate.
The ribbon, the Setup pane and the new-op door keep the active mount.

The #343 one-mount refusals are retired: an inactive setup's op
generates on its own machine without activation, and a program whose
setups span machines or posts posts one file per mount
(posting::post_mounts, <stem>_<nn>_<setups>.<ext>), each byte-identical
to posting that setup alone. Per-op files post each op through its own
setup's post and machine. The UI Post command, cam.post, MCP post and
CLI process -o follow; a one-mount program is one file, unchanged.

Fixes #388
